Subject: Azure co-sell: marketplace listing → field seller cueing flow

Team / Alex —

Quick note to align on how Contoso's Azure Marketplace listing should map to field sellers when a referral signal comes through Partner Center. Contoso has an assigned AE in the West region; they want marketplace leads to route to that AE (and their reseller) instead of generic market routing.

What I need:
- Confirmation from Marketplace ops on the fields Partner Center exposes in the referral payload (especially partnerContact, sellingRegion, and partnerConsent).
- A short mapping table that ties listing SKU / marketplace offer IDs -> Contoso account id -> AE email. I attached a working matrix (contoso_listing_account_matrix.xlsx) — please update where needed.
- An operational proposal for how we persist consent/ownership (e.g., stamp a referral record in our intake pipeline and prevent re-routing for 30 days).

Proposed next steps:
1) Alex or MP Ops update the matrix with confirmed offer IDs (by EOD Monday).
2) Vanessa drafts a routing SOP and consent retention rule for Partner Center referrals.
3) Karthik to confirm if we should prefer AE assignment over regional default in the routing policy.

Alex — looped you in to confirm Contoso's preference and provide any additional constraints (reseller routing, existing MPN mappings).

Thanks,

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head, Marketplace Integrations
Redwood Inference
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 12:10:00 -07:00
From: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@contoso.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Azure Marketplace Partner Ops <mpnpartner@microsoft.com>
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell: marketplace listing → field seller cueing flow

Thanks Marcus — good framing. A few clarifications from our side:

- Contoso wants marketplace leads that match the offer IDs in the attached matrix routed to our assigned AE (Rebecca Li) and to our reseller partner team (reseller-team@contoso.com). We want to avoid generic distribution lists where possible.
- We do have consent captured at purchase and are happy to provide a one-click sales consent form for routing. I've attached a signed consent baseline (contoso_consenter_signed.pdf) — it covers the baseline routing and contact release policy.
- We also need a short TTL on re-assignment: if a lead was routed to Contoso in the last 60 days, it should not be re-routed to a different AE without an explicit override.

If MP ops can confirm the referral payload fields, we can mark the Offer → Account mapping as final and begin a small pilot (100 leads) to validate routing accuracy.

Appreciate the quick help here.

—Alex
Alex Dunn
Cloud GTM Lead, Contoso
alex.dunn@contoso.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@contoso.com>, Azure Marketplace Partner Ops <mpnpartner@microsoft.com>
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell: marketplace listing → field seller cueing flow

All — pulling together an ops proposal and a minimal implementation plan. Notes below and action items at the end.

Summary (short): we can implement a deterministic routing layer in our intake pipeline that evaluates, in order: 1) Offer ID -> Account mapping (exact match), 2) Partner consent flag, 3) last-handled TTL (60 days per Contoso), 4) regional AE fallback. If a mapping exists, route to the mapped AE + reseller.

Routing details (technical):
- Inbound referral payload fields we will use: offerId, partnerId, partnerContactEmail, sellingRegion, consentToken.
- On intake, we lookup offerId in the Contoso mapping table; if found, we stamp a referral record (referral_id, routed_to, routing_reason, timestamp) in our ReferralStore.
- TTL: we will check ReferralStore for existing referrals for the same external lead email or account id; if routed within 60 days, we will not reassign unless the override flag is set by a Redwood CS/AE.
- Audit: all routed referrals will emit a tracing event to the Console and include a link to the SharePoint mapping document for verification.

Pilot plan (2 weeks):
- Day 0–2: Confirm mapping sheet and offer IDs with Contoso & MP Ops.
- Day 3–9: Deploy routing rule to staging; run 200 synthetic referrals to verify stability.
- Day 10–14: Soft launch to production with a 100-lead pilot. Monitor misroutes and latency.

Open questions:
- MP Ops: can you confirm whether partnerContactEmail is always populated for Partner Center referrals? If not, we need a fallback using partnerId -> MPN linkage.
- Karthik: do we want the TTL configurable per partner from the Console? (Contoso asked 60 days; others might want 30 or 90.)

Action items:
- Alex: update the attached matrix with the official offer IDs (Due: Wed EOD).
- MP Ops: confirm payload field availability and whether partnerId maps 1:1 to MPN membership.
- Karthik & Marcus: decide whether TTL should be a Console-level toggle or a hardcoded rule for the pilot.

I'll draft the routing SOP (one-pager) and a short QA checklist and share by EOD today.

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partner Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@contoso.com>, Azure Marketplace Partner Ops <mpnpartner@microsoft.com>
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell: marketplace listing → field seller cueing flow

Vanessa — looks good to me. A couple of quick points: 

- TTL should be configurable per-partner from the Console. We'll default to 60 days for Contoso for the pilot but expose the control in the routing rule UI so CS/partner ops can change it without an engineering deploy.
- We should also capture a routing confidence score (0–100) when we route by offerId vs region fallback. That will help the pilot telemetry and regression alerts.

Approved to proceed with the pilot plan. Marcus — please confirm you have signoff from Contoso on the mapping sheet once Alex updates it and we'll book a staging push for Wed.

Karthik
Director, GTM Platforms
Redwood Inference
